verdict.rationale: Recurly documents usage-based billing with measured units and end-of-cycle charging (recurly-docs-3, recurly-docs-4, recurly-docs-17), which covers the basic metering concept, but there is no evidence of a high-volume streaming ingestion API, idempotent event submission, or backdating of usage records. missing for 10: dedicated usage-event ingestion/streaming API, explicit idempotency-key support for usage records, explicit backdating/timestamp-override capability for usage events.
